summary: FHLBNY filed a routine Form 8-K furnishing its monthly President's Report to shareholders, covering August 2026 activity. The report highlights the 2026 Affordable Housing Program Round announced August 20, 2026, awarding $70.9 million in grants across 47 affordable housing initiatives — its second-largest round ever — supporting creation or preservation of over 2,400 affordable homes and roughly $850 million in related development activity. No securities, transaction, or corporate-action terms are disclosed. As a cooperative GSE filing a routine shareholder communication, it presents no merger-arbitrage or event-driven angle; watch only for future capital or business updates.
